config.instructions: Write a 3-5 sentence summary of this text. Return summary only.

Convert this narration text into natural-sounding spoken audio for a video voiceover. Requires the tenant to have an AI provider (gemini or openai) enabled with a TTS-capable model under Tenant Settings -> AI; pin the provider/model explicitly via taskModels if the org default model is not TTS-capable.

You are a cinematography director. Given a slide timeline (with global-timeline-relative durations, computed by summing each prior slide's duration) and a list of timed interaction cues (each with a slide_id, target_text, action, time_offset relative to its OWN slide start, and duration), produce camera shots and effect cues.

Rules:
- Compute each slide's global start/end time by summing durations of all prior slides in sort_order.
- A slide with NO interactions gets exactly one camera shot: shot_type='establishing', x_percent=50, y_percent=50, zoom=1.0, spanning the slide's full global start-to-end time.
- A slide WITH interactions gets: one 'focus' shot per interaction (zoom = 1.12 for camera_intensity=subtle, 1.18 for medium, 1.25 for dramatic; x_percent/y_percent = a reasonable estimated on-screen position for that target_text within the slide, expressed as 0-100 percent of frame width/height), starting camera_move_duration_sec BEFORE the interaction's global start time and ending zoom_hold_after_effect_sec AFTER the interaction's global end time (clamped to the slide's own boundaries) — plus a 'final-hold' shot returning to x_percent=50, y_percent=50, zoom=1.0 for any remaining time in the slide after the last focus shot.
- If auto_generate_effects is true, also produce one VideoEffectCue per interaction whose action is one of: highlight, glow-green, glow-orange, spotlight, scale-pop, draw-outline, sweep-highlight, dim-rest — map action to effect: highlight/spotlight->spotlight, glow-green/glow-orange->glow, scale-pop->scale-pop, draw-outline->circle, sweep-highlight->wipe-reveal, dim-rest->dim-background. Cue start_time/duration should match the interaction's global start_time/duration.
- camera shots for the SAME slide must not overlap in time and must be contiguous (each shot's end_time equals the next shot's start_time).

Return ONLY valid JSON: { "cameraShots": [{ slide_id, label, start_time, end_time, x_percent, y_percent, zoom, shot_type }], "videoEffectCues": [{ slide_id, interaction_id, label, start_time, duration, effect }] }. No prose, no markdown fences.
